name: Iringa
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate first-party discovery checks in English and Swahili identified Iringa Municipal Council/regional land administration and the Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi portal. The current public e-Ardhi routes expose service descriptions and registration/login flows, but no anonymous parcel viewer, service configuration, schema/CRS, or bounded safe ID+geometry response. No GeoJSON sample was created.
